topic: Are more colour pigments to discover?
core_finding: New material pigments remain plausible; a new pigment does not create a new fundamental human color dimension.
required_invariants: Do not claim observed pigment synthesis or discovery.
Retain the distinction between pigment identity, reflectance spectrum, and color appearance.
Define novelty against a declared reference library and viewing conditions.
Treat multiobjective material performance and uncertainty as first-class criteria.
recommended_problem_formulation: Can a safety-constrained, uncertainty-aware multiobjective search identify candidate pigment materials predicted to extend a defined reference library's usable spectral–perceptual–engineering Pareto frontier?
unknowns: Which pigment family has adequate open data and acceptable sustainability constraints?
What reference library represents the intended application market?
What separation and engineering thresholds are appropriate for the intended use?
